lines: Save Creator: new Riven Tier unlock under the Rupture Level. Ticking it sets the Rupture Level to 200 and opens a box for the Riven Tier to unlock; Riven points come with the tiers (one at tier 5, 10 and 15, then one every 25).
Support gems: Kindling now counts against Guardians (every 4% of the Guardian's life your spell deals counts as a kill: about 0 to 2% more damage on most builds).
Repeat on channelled skills (Cyclone, Storm Whirl, Drain Life) now adds its extra strike; before, only its less damage counted.
Chain Detonation: traps set off in a chain now deal 8% more for each trap down the chain. Rallying Standard raises the War Banner's Valour cap to 30.
War Banner: maximum Valour from the passive tree, Oaths and uniques, and increased War Banner effect, now count. Melee Splash, Ruinous Herald and Spreading Pyre are marked as pack-only supports.

Ladder: new Gem used filter: find heroes using a skill or support anywhere in their build (Trap, Spell Totem, Jarl's Roar...), not just as main skill. Covers the top 50 of each class (published builds).
Ladder: the Skill filter is now called Main skill. In a hero's build, skills not on the hotbar are greyed out and listed last.
Ladder: the Rupture Level spread and Ascendancies boxes are gone from the Meta panel.
Ladder: a slow or failed answer now shows an error instead of loading forever; changing a filter tries again.

A shock from another skill on your bar now counts for all your skills: for example a Cast on Crit Lightning Arrow shocking the enemy raises your main skill's damage, and the tree optimizer sees it (game logs). Each such skill is listed under Vows, Heralds & charges, where you can untick it.
Translations: the Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot options, gear level presets, the New first sort in Item Search and a few other new lines are now in all page languages.
Item Search: the Forged copy lines of uniques show the ×1.1 / ×1.35 tag properly again (raw page code showed instead).

Woe of Withering on a Guardian now counts at its biggest line (the Poison one) for all your damage, inside the "only the strongest" choice; its two lines no longer add, and with Death Sentence on it adds nothing (game logs).
Unique items: a new Base choice puts the unique on a Core Touched base of its kind (the cube's Vowbinding: the Mark). Its lines and Vows stay, and the base's Mark counts as its implicit.

Weapons now show Weapon DPS and Average hit: in the Character tab's item window, on weapon cards when picking an item (uniques at mid rolls), in Item Search and in the item tooltip. Average hit leaves out attack speed, for skills like Ballista.

Unique items: the game's latest scaling table is in (121 lines on 57 uniques). Six new uniques are covered, among them The Thousand Sparks and primal Kingbreaker, Gravesong, Gravecleaver, Stormfang and Rimecrown Staff; Cinderwick (primal) lines changed.

Bina's Spotter's Helm (Patch 81): the crit volley now comes every 2 seconds instead of 3, and Ballista or totem shots in a row at the same rare or Guardian deal up to 50% more (2% per shot). From the patch notes; switches on with the game's build 81 data.
Item Search: "New this patch first" is now a purple New first button next to All. It puts this patch's items on top while keeping your category, filters and sort for the rest.
Item editor: picking a different unique no longer keeps the old item's Vows when the new base can't roll them (a quiver kept a shield's Vows). A Vow its base can't roll is now marked in red.
Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: a new Basic items only box skips Core Touched and Ashen bases (on for Midgame). The options now sit next to the gear level.
Gear Set Sim: with the Defence slider or max resistances on, a new column shows each slot's DPS change, apart from the score.

Gear Set Sim, Sim by Slot and Item Compare now check Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence requirements: the searches only suggest items you can put on, and Item Compare says when the new item needs more than you have. Tick Ignore attribute requirements for the old behaviour.
Damage: Patch 80 rules. Viper Fang deals about 29% less at high gem levels, and the Sleepy's Continental Strap poison burst now uses up the poisons still to come instead of adding damage.
Oathword items now show the runes they are made of next to the name, for example Bladesong (Tyr + Reid + Dagaz + Perthro), in the Item Simulator and in the item tooltip.

Support Gem Simulator: on translated pages the search results now show support names in your language (they stayed English when two or more were listed), and the rest of that window is translated too.
Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: a new Gear level choice (Midgame, Endgame, BiS or Custom) sets how good and how rare the items tried are.

FAQ: new Forge & Crafting, Cube, Vows & Runes and Attributes sections. Lightless Anneal reaches the best tier only from Rupture 160; Gloomsilver crafts, Forge levels, Vow costs and rune rules are explained.
